newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bank Melb CEO leaves for ANZ.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bank Melb CEO leaves for ANZ.

text.p: Bank of Melbourne Ltd chief executive David Airey has resigned and will take up an appointment as managing director of the Australia and New Zealand Banking Group's New Zealand operations, the banks announced on Tuesday.
Airey will take up his new position as managing director, ANZ Banking Group (New Zealand) Ltd, on March 1, ANZ said.
Bank of Melbourne said chief financial officer Robert Giles would act as chief executive, and chairman Christopher Stewart as executive chairman, until a permanent appointment was made.
"We are delighted to welcome David Airey to ANZ's senior executive team," ANZ chief executive Don Mercer said.

"I believe David's experience and understanding of both the Australian and New Zealand economies and banking systems will stand him in good stead to lead ANZ's operations in New Zealand and contribute to the growth and progress of ANZ in future."
